effectgroup.name: OuzFX AFX_Move_Overshoot_Slide_Out_Bottom
effectgroup.description: Anticipation exit, the exact time-reverse of Overshoot_Slide_In_Bottom: winds up the other way (Kdenlive/MLT back ease-in, ≈ 37% of the travel), then shoots out to the bottom with a motion-blur tail (14 frames). Razor 14 frames before the end of the clip and drop it on that last piece – the layer is gone on the last frame (anything after stays hidden).
